loss_basis: Simultaneous moves from midpoint to the existing low GF savings/receipt estimates. HLT-6 uses its GF share only. No probabilities, additional macro feedback, or additional GX haircut.
net_revenue_space_note: Unallocated NET financing requirement, not a tax proposal or a scored yield. Net of any household compensation. Begins 2030 and reaches full size in 2034; remains permanent.

housing.basis: Award path and 5% administration allowance are reviewer assumptions; $15,200 FY2026 voucher-year anchor and 3% growth inherited from HOU-4. Half-year first-award cost, full lease-up, no attrition. No rent or supply response. Beyond the adopted one million, not a new total or the full entitlement cost. Administration may overlap source renewals: 5% is a conservative explicit allowance, not a score.

care_note: Illustrative gross annual home-support arithmetic in constant 2026 dollars. Neither population nor price is an estimated national caseload/rate. Excludes assessment, capital, administration, intensive care and offsets. Not fed into nominal fiscal paths.
